name: yarta-backend
description: Yarta live backend: Firebase security rules, rule tests and the browser data layer bundle

scripts.test:rules: env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-yarta "node --test --test-reporter=spec test/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.emulators: env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-yarta
